items.summary: Maintain the small readiness pipeline of complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. All remain private and preview-only; no domain additions, spend, deployment, publication, monetization, or telemetry changes are authorized. Use one reusable launch packet covering site brief, audience and positioning, bounded template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics readiness, affiliate readiness, compliance checklist, security checklist, measurement boundary, rollback point, owner/legal/security/measurement gates, and explicit launch gate. Analytics, operations, and material security evidence remain unavailable or incomplete; preserve unknowns and do not invent telemetry. Exactly one next step: site-factory completes the existing complicated.work readiness packet with dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance and security dispositions, measurement boundaries, rollback, and a private-preview launch decision.
